name: TC-AN-QB-011 — 批量填写：重复empId去重验证 [P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域有人员
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { /* 记录导入前的参与人数 */ const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); if (!container) return { beforeCount: -1 }; return { beforeCount: container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); /* 输入含重复empId + 与已有参与人重复的JSON */ const dupJson = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝重复'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, dupJson); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, inputted: dupJson }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认导入')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); /* 检查是否有去重相关的toast信息 */ const hasDedup = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('总计') || t.includes('去重') || t.includes('重复') || t.includes('新增')); const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); const afterCount = container ? container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length : -1; return { toastTexts, hasDedup, afterCount }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域有人员
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 粘贴含重复empId的JSON: 同一empId出现2次 + 与已有参与人重复\n3. 点击「确认导入」
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 相同empId不重复添加（输入内去重）\n2. 与已有参与人重复的项不重复写入（跨批次去重）\n3. toast中体现实际新增数（含去重后的真实值）
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
